responsibility: Provides the generated user-manual reference fragment for the RISC-V @option{-mtune=} option. Automatically produced from the RISC-V backend core definitions in @file{gcc/config/riscv/riscv-cores.def}, this file documents the permissible microarchitecture and CPU tuning names that affect scheduling and performance heuristics without necessarily changing the selected ISA, including generic tuning profiles and the note that all valid @option{-mcpu=} names are also accepted for tuning.
